title: Active military personnel bring UAP videos to the congressman

tellings.quote: I get people from that are active military personnel that come to me as a member of Congress and and have videos that they they'll show me

plain: Service members still on active military duty have been coming to Congressman Eric Burlison and showing him their own videos of unexplained aerial objects, which the government calls UAP. Burlison says this has happened to him personally since about 2023 in his role as a member of Congress. If true, it would mean people inside the military are bypassing their chain of command to get evidence to lawmakers.
